subject: problem with QA plots and zero hugene ST 1.0 array expression values

messages.author: a1cfadbfa14f7b87
messages.subject: problem with QA plots and zero hugene ST 1.0 array expression values
parts:
Dear All
 
I hope I am complying with group protocol, my apologies if not.
I have tried to process 2 different sets of human gene ST 1.0 array cel files with the code below
 and each time I get an error with plotNUSE and plotRLE
“ in plot.window(xlim = xlim, ylim = ylim, log = log, yaxs = pars$yaxs) :
  NAs not allowed in 'ylim' “
 
And when I try to look at the expression values with head(gExprs)
All appear zero
tName groupName unit group cell cel1 cel2
1  7892501              1     1    1         0         0
2  7892502              2     1    2         0         0
3  789 ....
 
I wonder if there is some obvious error in my code or whether its likely I’ve not installed or downloaded some file ?
Many thanks in advance for any help
 
 
library(affy)
library(aroma.affymetrix)
 
# Place the CDF for chip type <chipType> in directory:
#  annotationData/chipTypes/<chip type>/
# http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/web/gene-1-0-st-array-analysis
 
verbose <- Arguments$getVerbose(-8, timestamp=TRUE)
chipType <- "HuGene-1_0-st-v1"
cdf <- AffymetrixCdfFile$byChipType(chipType, tags="r3")
print(cdf)
 
# Place the cels for chip type <chipType> in directory:
# rawData/tissues/<chip type>/
cs <- AffymetrixCelSet$byName("tissues", cdf=cdf)
class(cs)
print(cs)
 
bc <- RmaBackgroundCorrection(cs)
csBC <- process(bc,verbose=verbose)
qn <- QuantileNormalization(csBC, typesToUpdate="pm")
class(qn)
print(qn)
csN <- process(qn, verbose=verbose)
class(csN)
 
#plm <- RmaPlm(cs)
plm <- RmaPlm(csN)
class(plm)
 
par(ask=T)
qam <- QualityAssessmentModel(plm)
plotNuse(qam)
plotRle(qam)
 
ces <- getChipEffectSet(plm)
gExprs <- extractDataFrame(ces, units=NULL, addNames=TRUE)
head(gExprs)
 
I am using R 2.10.0 with the following sessionInfo
 
R version 2.10.0 (2009-10-26)
i386-pc-mingw32
 
locale:
[1] LC_COLLATE=English_United Kingdom.1252
[2] LC_CTYPE=English_United Kingdom.1252  
[3] LC_MONETARY=English_United Kingdom.1252
[4] LC_NUMERIC=C                          
[5] LC_TIME=English_United Kingdom.1252   
 
attached base packages:
[1] stats     graphics  grDevices utils     datasets  methods   base    
 
other attached packages:
 [1] aroma.affymetrix_1.4.0 aroma.apd_0.1.7        affxparser_1.18.0    
 [4] R.huge_0.2.0           aroma.core_1.4.0       aroma.light_1.15.1   
 [7] matrixStats_0.1.8      R.rsp_0.3.6            R.filesets_0.7.0     
[10] digest_0.4.2           R.cache_0.2.0          R.utils_1.3.2        
[13] R.oo_1.6.7             R.methodsS3_1.1.0      affy_1.24.2          
[16] Biobase_2.6.0

parts:
You need to fit the PLM, i.e. call fit(plm).

/Henrik
